FOSDice.Title: Game companion
FOSDice.Visibility: Visibility in chat and game log
FOSDice.FormulaHelp: Supports Foundry formulas such as 2d20kh + 4 for advantage.
FOSDice.ApiUnavailable: The Foundry dice API is not available.
FOSDice.NoWhisperRecipients: This private roll has no recipients.
FOSDice.RollFailed: The roll could not be completed.
FOSDice.CharacterSettingHint: Private game connection link or public character sheet link. Stored only in this Foundry client.
FOSDice.CharacterShareHelp: For shared game state, create a link under “Connect Foundry” on the game page and paste it here. A public character link stores actions only in Foundry.
FOSDice.InvalidShareHost: The link must originate from fantasy-os.com.
FOSDice.InvalidShareUrl: The share link or key is invalid.
FOSDice.CharacterNotFound: The character was not found or the share has expired.
FOSDice.CharacterServiceUnavailable: The Fantasy-OS character API is currently unavailable.
FOSDice.StateScope: State belongs to this Foundry world and your player. Syncing the character preserves spent mana and uses.
FOSDice.CatalogIncomplete: Additional class and ancestry abilities could not be loaded. Please synchronize again later. Saved spells and custom actions remain available.
FOSDice.NoActions: No matching actions. You can add custom abilities.
FOSDice.NoItems: No equipment on this character sheet.
FOSDice.RestRule: Restore DP; regenerate HP or mana
FOSDice.EffectOnlyHint: Roll effects separately; no additional resources are spent.
FOSDice.ConfirmLongRest: Restore all resources to their maxima and reset short/long rest counters?
FOSDice.ConfirmRemove: Remove this action or its saved configuration?
FOSDice.ActionFailed: The action could not be saved. Please try again.
FOSDice.ActionMissing: The action is no longer available.
FOSDice.InvalidOutcomes: Check the outcome table: e.g. 1-2 = Nothing or 3 = Shield (1d6).
FOSDice.StateVersionUnsupported: This game state needs a newer module version.
FOSDice.StateLoadFailed: The saved game state cannot be read. It has not been overwritten.
FOSDice.ActionBusy: Please wait for the current action.
FOSDice.ChatFailedStateSaved: State saved, but chat message failed. Do not repeat the action.
FOSDice.ConfigureHelp: Cost 0 means no mana. Unlimited means no use limit. Returning a use does not refund mana. AP are displayed and managed manually, as in the portal.
FOSDice.InvalidGameConnection: Invalid game connection link. Copy the complete link from Fantasy-OS.
FOSDice.GameStateScope: Shared state and action log in Fantasy-OS:
FOSDice.GameStateUnavailable: The game state has not been loaded yet.
FOSDice.GameAccessDenied: Game access has expired or was revoked. Create a new link on the game page.
FOSDice.GameSyncFailed: The game could not confirm the transfer.
FOSDice.PendingGameAction: An action is awaiting confirmation. Retry its transfer before performing further actions. Mana and uses will be deducted only once.
